title: Add contrastive rollback responder for flaky prompt-sets
author: Lena Ortiz
release_notes: Added a CI responder that performs contrastive reprobes for unstable prompt-sets and surfaces rollback suggestions with telemetry. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We keep seeing intermittent regressions on a small subset of prompt-sets: standard smoke/eval gates will flip between pass/fail across runs and the root cause is often brittle prompt construction or non-deterministic model behavior. This PR introduces a CI-side 'contrastive rollback responder' that: 1) automatically detects unstable prompt-sets based on historical variance + single-run flips, 2) schedules prioritized contrastive reprobes (small perturbations, different random seeds and shot orders) to determine whether the failure is persistent or stochastic, and 3) when consensus indicates a genuine regression, annotates the CI failure with an automated rollback suggestion and a Linear ticket draft for on-call to review.

Key features implemented (high level):
- New eval hook module eval/hooks/contrastive_rollback.py implementing the probe orchestration and decision logic (consensus window, quorum threshold, backoff policy).
- Telemetry metrics: eval.flakiness.score, eval.reprobe.rate, eval.rollback.suggested, eval.contrastive.consensus (exposed to console + prometheus bridge).
- Small scheduler layer added to CI pipeline that will enqueue at-most-one reprobe-per-prompt-set-per-hour and rate-limit at 10 reprobes/min across the agent.
- Integration with Linear API to auto-populate a rollback draft (title + linked commits + reprobe summary) when the consensus threshold is exceeded.
- Two new unit test modules + integration smoke tests exercising consensus and backoff behavior. Deterministic seed harness included to avoid flakiness in tests.
- Docs: docs/ci/contrastive-rollback.md describing the flow, configuration knobs, and SLOs.

Checklist (PR):
- [x] Implementation code and tests
- [x] CI workflow adjusted to run reprobe orchestration stage (conditional)
- [x] Telemetry hooks wired to existing metrics exporter
- [x] Docs added and linked

Commits summary (high level):

Files changed (overview):

- eval/tests/test_contrastive_rollback.py (new)
- ci/workflows/eval.yml (modified: add reprobe stage)
- docs/ci/contrastive-rollback.md (new)
- telemetry/metrics_map.py (modified: add metric names)
- examples/replay/fixtures/flake_trace.json (new small fixture)

Design notes / decision points:
- We intentionally keep reprobes small (<=5 perturbations) to bound cost; the decision gating uses a Bayesian consensus score (posterior probability of systematic regression) with a conservative threshold (0.95) to avoid false rollbacks.
- Reprobe perturbations include: seed variation, shot-order shuffle, synthetic paraphrase via existing paraphrase-prober, and short suffix noise. These are chosen to exercise typical non-determinism sources without changing prompt semantics.
- The module is pluggable: teams can opt-out via CI config (eval.contrastive_rollback.enabled=false) or tune threshold/backoff.

Review conversation (selected highlights, chronological):
- Marco Santoro (review): "Nice approach. Two asks: 1) can we expose the consensus math in a small helper doc and include a unit test that demonstrates a borderline consensus case? 2) threshold 0.95 seems high for small sample counts — please add a comment explaining the safety tradeoff."
- Lena Ortiz (author): "Added a worked example in docs/ci/contrastive-rollback.md and a unit test for the edge-case. Kept 0.95 but left it configurable; added comments explaining tradeoffs."
- Jin Park (review): "Please wire a tag so we can query reprobes easily in Grafana (e.g., reprobe.origin=contrastive_responder). Also add the rollback draft payload example in the docs so on-call knows what to expect."
- Lena Ortiz: "Added tag and sample payload. Also added labels on the Linear draft: rollback, triage-required."
- Aisha Khan (review & approval): "Left one nit on variable naming; otherwise LGTM. Thanks for the tests and docs."

CI timeline / statuses:
- Initial CI run: failed linting on metrics names (fixed in b2d4c7a), re-run.
- Second CI run: failed a flaky unit test due to non-deterministic harness; fixed by seeding in c3e5f1d.
- Final CI run: all checks passed (unit, integration smoke, lint, typecheck). Merge allowed.

Merge outcome: Squash merged to main by Aisha Khan on 2024-08-20. The commit message includes a short summary and links to ENG-4923 and SUP-1284.

Operational notes for on-call / SRE:
- Metric to watch: eval.flakiness.score > 0.7 correlated with reprobe volume increase.
- If rollback drafts start accumulating, increase reprobe consensus threshold or reduce reprobe window; defaults are conservative to minimize false positives.
- The Linear drafts created include a link to the failed test trace fixture and reprobe summary for faster triage.

Backcompat / rollout: opt-in by default for all repos in the CI config; rollout plan: enable for 10% of repos for 48 hours, then gradually to 100% pending telemetry review. Configuration knobs are documented in docs/ci/contrastive-rollback.md.
